input: # A directive may be written in object form, @{path: ...}, and the path
# value need not be a string. The canonical coerces it with `'' + spec.path`,
# which for a number is ECMA-262 Number::toString: exponent form only at
# 1e21 and 1e-7, and no sign on negative zero. A port that formats the
# number its own way names a DIFFERENT source, so these rows hold two
# candidate names and assert which one is loaded.
